metadataRaw.title: 3 Exercises for Instant FULL BACK Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 3 easy exercises that may give quick full back pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

These stretches and exercises are designed to target as many muscles (and spots) throughout the whole back in the shortest amount of time. 

Each exercise works a little bit different. To get the best results, go through all three and use what gives you the most relief. As a bonus, all of the stretches and exercises can be done at home, and require no equipment. 

Watch now for quick full back pain relief!

0:50 Child's Cobra 
4:22 Back, Butt, and Hips Bridge
